lines.3: 「Why don't you knock...? This is practically a running gag now.」
lines.4: 「Yeah, it really is. (Smile and play it off.)」
lines.6: 「Anyway, you don't need to make lunch for me anymore.」
lines.8: 「Can I stop sitting in seiza now?」
lines.9: 「No. You need more time to reflect.」
lines.10: 「Complain one more time while you're in seiza and I will punish you with my fist.」
lines.13: 「Finally, I'm free. My legs are numb.」
lines.15: 「Yeah, I managed to eat with them.」
lines.16: 「You really don't know until you ask. Thanks.」
lines.17: 「See? When you have an idea, act on it.」
lines.18: 「So for now, I'll be eating lunch with the Princess and Yoshimi.」
lines.20: 「...I appreciate it, but stop feeding the Princess exaggerated stories about me.」
lines.21: 「Hey, it was my way of providing covering fire. Yaaawn...」
lines.22: 「You look exhausted... Just make sure your covering fire doesn't hit your own side.」
lines.25: Honestly, what am I going to do with him?
lines.26: I pulled a light blanket over Subaru.
lines.27: I guess I could give him half the bed.
